description: Use after the deck's end belief and style are settled, to inform the storyline in the text plan (see get_playbook). Searches the library's deck flows (how strong decks order their sections) by what the whole deck must achieve, before find_references. Returns up to 3 summaries (deck id, arc, length, industry, style, section sequence, why the flow works, score). Call get_reference with a deck id for its steps and their slide ids.

length.description: short: up to 10 slides, medium: 11 to 25, long: more.

purpose.description: What the whole deck must achieve, in plain words.

style.description: Only decks with this overall look.
